REGIME CALL: risk-off, escalated conviction vs the 11:40 read this same day. Rationale -- (1) the Hormuz conflict has moved from announced-blockade to live kinetic exchange (missile strikes on tankers, fresh US strikes on Iran) plus the blockade/fee now actually in effect as of 4pm today; (2) oil has continued climbing through the session (Brent $85.5 -> $87.34, +4.85% 1d) rather than stabilizing after yesterday's spike; (3) PSX's own intraday tape has deepened from -1.27% yesterday to as much as -2.95% today, broad-based across index-heavy names; (4) the desk's independent georisk radar sits at 60/100 moderate with conflict stress maxed; (5) domestic anchors (SBP hold, easing CPI, on-track IMF program, adequate reserves, easing T-bill/PIB yields) are genuine positives that argue against a full panic/capitulation read, but they predate and cannot offset a live, worsening chokepoint conflict that hits Pakistan disproportionately through the oil-import bill and current account. Net: stay risk-off, defensive/beneficiary sectors only, max 2 new setups per desk rules, tight monitoring of existing positions.
